triples.tail_surface: recorded with indication of the pressure variation showing the maximum overpressure and steady under pressure
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 记录压力变化指示最大超压和稳定负压
triples.evidence_text: The pressure rise and decay during an explosion is to be recorded with indication of the pressure variation showing the maximum overpressure and steady under pressure in the test vessel during testing.

triples.tail_surface: verifying from records at the time of testing that an underpressure of at least 0.3 bar (3.06 kgf/cm2, 43.5 psi) is held by the test vessel for at least 10 seconds following an explosion
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 验证测试容器在爆炸后保持至少0.3巴负压至少10秒的记录
triples.evidence_text: The valve tightness is to be ascertained by verifying from records at the time of testing that an underpressure of at least 0.3 bar (3.06 kgf/cm2, 43.5 psi) is held by the test vessel for at least 10 seconds following an explosion.

triples.tail_surface: examined for signs of serious damage and/or deformation
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 检查严重损坏和/或变形迹象
triples.evidence_text: After each explosion test in Stage 2, (see 4-2-1-A2/13.3.2), the external condition of the flame arrester is to be examined for signs of serious damage and/or deformation that may affect the operation of the valve.

triples.tail_surface: signs of serious damage and/or deformation

triples.evidence_text: the external condition of the flame arrester is to be examined for signs of serious damage and/or deformation that may affect the operation of the valve

triples.tail_surface: dismantled and the condition of all components ascertained and documented
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 拆卸并确认及记录所有部件状况
triples.evidence_text: After completing the explosion tests, the valves are to be dismantled and the condition of all components ascertained and documented.
In particular, any indication of valve sticking or uneven opening that may affect operation of the valve is to be noted.
